verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an official Python SDK (pymilvus with MilvusClient), used across Lite, Standalone and Distributed with the same client code. Nothing in the pack shows official TypeScript, Go or Java SDKs, so only one of the four requested languages is covered. Missing for 10: evidence of official TypeScript/Node, Go and Java SDKs, SDK reference docs per language, and independent corroboration of multi-language SDK quality.
